cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check .env
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep SUPABASE /opt/areloria/.env 2>&1 | head -5")
print(".env:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
.env: SUPABASE_AUTH=true
